stations.label: Commander
stations.notes: Officer; front cab beside the driver. Receives designations from the battery PU-12 by radio and gives the orders. The АПУ controls here are SAM3D placements (their real seat isn't known); power is the driver's (PU-303, rwd_mb3).

stations.label: Deputy commander
stations.notes: Launch console (key, ПУСК ГОТОВ, missile selection), elevation wheel and dial, TV monitor. Control ids keep SAM Simulator's 'fo.' (Firing Officer) prefix.

stations.label: Senior operator
stations.notes: Search radar (SOC) scope, IFF, azimuth wheel: puts the target under the SSC azimuth line.

stations.label: Operator
stations.notes: Range indicator and range wheel; SSC transmitter and capture (ТСЦ). The NVA senior operator also sets the range mark on the search scope; SAM3D has one range wheel, so it is the operator's (sam3d).

stations.label: Driver
stations.notes: Front cab. Works the power supply: the power-supply control panel PU-303 is at his left (rwd_mb3).

launch.notes: Restarts: after a launch ПУСК ГОТОВ goes out and lights again when the next missile can be launched (p30). The manual gives no time; SAM3D repeats missile preparation (the 15 s spin-up), confidence estimate.

tuning.source: r123m_training (selecting a fixed frequency, the knobs turn by themselves until they stop; smooth tuning only at a halt, because the vibration shifts an unlocked frequency; the antenna tuned to the meter's highest reading, the lamp brightest)
tuning.notes: All four numbers are SAM3D estimates: the motors' 3 s, the antenna circuit's half-width of 5 knob divisions, a drift of 2 kHz a second on the move in smooth tuning (the net is lost within about 6 s), and the lamp at its brightest from 90 % of the peak.

subscribers.source: r124_refs (A-2 can go on a radio); r123m_training
subscribers.notes: The second box that can go on a radio; the deputy's is SAM3D's choice.
Which operator has which box is in no source found: SAM3D's choice.

subscribers.source: r124_photos (A-4 sold with A-1 and A-2)
subscribers.notes: The driver's plain box; his ВС / РС is the ПВ switch.

comms.source: r123m_training (ranges on a medium-rough route at up to 40 km/h: 4 m whip at least 20 km with the noise suppressor off and up to 13 km with it on, 1 m whip up to 8 km, emergency wire up to 4 km); r124_refs; the shouting times are SAM3D estimates
comms.notes: The range figures become losses in the receiving chain with the EM layer's plane-earth law (40 log10 of the range ratio against the 4 m whip with the suppressor off), applied to the set the headset is on. They matter only to a link made by the EM layer's radio sources. Shouting: without the commander's box, or for a crew member whose own box is on the radio, an order takes shout_quiet_s to arrive (shout_noisy_s while the turbine or the take-off generator runs): estimates, with the R-124's own specification of 90 % word intelligibility at 120 dB of noise as the reason a box is needed at all.

letter.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p150 (СМЕНА ЛИТЕРЫ — НОРМА changes the transmitter's frequency letter; ЗАХВ. АПЧ-I, -II go out and back within 1 s); mon_2112_80 (a faulty channel: КАНАЛЫ to the good one, single missiles, then СМЕНА ЛИТ.)
letter.notes: Entering СМЕНА ЛИТ. is one change. ПУСК ГОТОВ waits for the transmitters to lock again. The number of letters and what the letter does against interference are not in any source found, so the letter itself is only counted.

prep_hold.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p248 (a prepared missile is held at most 10 min, then the next is prepared; a missile can be prepared again after 10 min; three cycles, then a 1 h break); samsim_thread (ePap: the ammunition lamp flashes if the gyro overheats)
prep_hold.notes: Read as: after 10 min prepared and waiting the gyro has overheated, the lamp flashes while it rests, 10 min after each hold and 1 h after the third. The textbook doesn't say what the lamp does; the flash is the forum's.

range_sweep.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98, p120 (switch on the range indicator: the fine range sweep is driven by the target range unit at ЦЕЛЬ, or by missile channel I or II's range unit); samsim_sprites osa014-016
range_sweep.notes: Р I follows the missile of channel I, Р II that of channel II, ЦЕЛЬ the target: the fine sweep is centred on it. Where the missile is: its average speed along the flight, not a flight model.

refuse.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p151, p156 (the switch and the button ОТКАЗ on the indication panel give the forced refusal of the missile standing on preparation), p248 (a dropped missile is prepared again after 10 min)
refuse.notes: The selector's positions are the missiles' табло names (p156, p247): SAM3D's reading. A refused missile rests as an overheated one does (prep_hold.rest_s).

emergency.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp150-156 (the emergency launch from the batteries: the missile flies with locked fins and climbs 24-27 s until it self-destructs; ИЗДЕЛИЯ picks the missile); samsim_thread (ePap: throws a missile off unguided)
emergency.notes: Flight time is the middle of the published 24-27 s. The throw uses no channel and no hit chance, and is not a guided launch in the debrief.

launcher.source: flak11 (NVA Osa-AK: at ВНИМАНИЕ the command transmitter comes on and two missiles are selected automatically, outer ones first, left and right; K3 about 120 m before the target); samsim_thread (creator: ЗАХВАТ about 0.8 s / 60 m after launch; ePap: the lamp sequence, К3 with УЗКИЙ ЛУЧ against a jamming target); korovin_tiv_2010 (the two missiles launched 3-5 s apart, each captured by its own wide- and medium-beam antennas); samsim_osa p30 (ПУСК ГОТОВ again for the second missile)
launcher.notes: Channel 1 = I (right launcher), 2 = II (left). 'Outer first': container 3 is taken as the outer one, from the order of the ИЗДЕЛИЯ selector (3-II ... 1-II, ОТКЛ., 1-I ... 3-I); sam3d estimate. In СОВМ. channel I fires first (sam3d estimate). medium_s and narrow_s (when СР.Л and УЗКИЙ ЛУЧ light) are sam3d estimates; min_interval_s 4 is inside Korovin's 3-5 s. The lamps stay lit as the missile goes through the beams and go out when the shot is over. nominal_flight_s only applies without the outcome model. Reloading: with tzm_alongside set and the vehicle stopped, outer containers first, only once the pair is spent and no channel is guiding; the crane's traverse holds up to 3 containers (flak11), so it lifts one side's empty containers at a time (reload_traverse 3), a lift taking 3 x 60 s: the 6 min for six as two lifts of 3 min (sam3d reading), however many the lift carries, and no more than the TZM still has aboard; the loading order is a sam3d estimate. Gyro overheating (flashing ammunition lamps) is prep_hold, the emergency launch emergency.

sources.source: samsim_thread (100 l/h on the move against the turbine's 75 at a halt: the 25 is the driving); voenizdat_osa_1991 p16-17 agrees (250 km on dirt roads with 2 h of the turbine from the tank: about 63 l per 100 km, 25 l/h at 40 km/h; docs/research/OSA_VEHICLE_SYSTEMS_2026-11.md section 1.4). At a halt its burn driving the take-off generator is that source's 25 l/h

fuel.source: samsim_thread (ePap: about 300 l tank; turbine about 75 l/h stationary and 100 l/h moving; take-off generator about 25 l/h; half the tank is kept for driving, and the crew asks for fuel at half); voenizdat_osa_1991 p163-164 agrees (the turbine 67 kg/h, about 80 l/h, at its 50 kW; the take-off generator 20 kg/h, about 24 l/h)
fuel.notes: Burning = the power source's subsystem is not off (it burns while starting). The take-off generator is taken as 25 l/h whether or not the vehicle moves (it only runs at a halt). At the reserve the crew asks for fuel (debrief) and both power sources are cut so the rest stays for driving; this reads 'half the tank is kept for driving' as a hard limit on the power sources. refuel_lpm 60 is a sam3d estimate (no source gives a refuelling rate): a full tank from the reserve in 2.5 min.

checks.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98-99 (0062-6M1: КАНАЛЫ, РЕЖИМЫ, КОНТРОЛЬ, ПОДЖИГ ГШ, РРУ КШ ОСН. and ДОП. for the noise figure), p157-162 (the function-check set: 0004-12M1's КОНТРОЛЬ СИСТЕМ, УРОВНИ КОМАНД, СМЕНА ЗНАКА, ПРОВЕРКА СМЕНЫ ЛИТЕРА, ПРОВЕРКА ПЕРЕХОДНЫХ ХАРАКТЕРИСТИК, ПУСК — ИСХ. ПОЛОЖ., ИП1 and ИП2; 0004-14M's РЕЖИМЫ, ВЫВОД — НАВЕДЕНИЕ, ЧАСТОТА and four meters; the noise generators ГШ-2 and ГШ-5)
checks.notes: What each check shows is the textbook's; the readings (of each meter's swing) and which position is which are SAM3D's, the sources giving none (docs/research/OSA_CHECKS_RECEIVERS_DRIVES_2026-11.md, "The checks' model"). simcore/checks.hpp reads them for the cabin's meters; the faults they find cost the shot (data/gameplay/osa_ak.json outcome.fault_factors) or the radars' range (noise.degraded_db).

commands.notes: 0004-12M1 (p159-162): the static task gives K1, K2 «a certain level» (p159); the passage of commands their standard levels with a sign, or the zero levels; the transients the channel the switch picks. Readings SAM3D's.

errors.notes: 0004-14M (p157-162): СО Ц, Р and its sign change swing both pairs, КОМПЕНС. nulls them, ПП ССЦ and ПП СОЦ (the MTI check) swing the target pair only; the deputy reads the target channel within 2 divisions (p247). ВЫВОД swings the missile pair wider than НАВЕДЕНИЕ (the gathering beam's scale), ЧАСТОТА off tune drops the target pair. Readings SAM3D's (they were the meters' levels until 15 Nov 2026).

channels.notes: ГШ-2 through the search radar's receiver to 0062-6M1 (p161)
ГШ-5, the tracking radar's first channel (p161: separately by two channels)

noise.notes: The Y-factor: with the knob set the receiver's own noise reads noise_per_gain x knob; the generator raises it generator_y times in a sound receiver, 1 + (generator_y - 1) / F in one whose noise figure is F = degraded_db worse. With the knob at mid-scale that is 0.30 alone, 0.60 with the generator, 0.38 degraded. The receivers' input stages are powered by the three-minute relay (p165). A degraded receiver loses degraded_db on every echo, a radar's reach falling to 10^(-degraded_db/40) (0.71 at 6 dB). All game values.

voice.source: r124_refs; r124_bmp2 (A-1 ВЫКЛ / ВС / Р-123 / Р-112, A-2 Р-112 / ВС / Р-123: two radios; the chest switch's ВЫЗ pulls those on the radio back); r123m_training (the one on the radio leaves the intercom); mon_2112_80 (two R-123M, the R-124, a TA-57)
voice.notes: A-1 on Р-123 keeps the intercom (the chest switch's ПРМ: receive and the intercom, r124_bmp2; SAM3D as before); A-2 and the driver's ПВ on the radio leave it, and the call (ВЫЗ) brings them back. Which seat holds A-2 to A-5 on the Osa is not documented: A-2 the deputy commander (the ZSU-23-4 analogue, tpu_zsu; the NVA's deputy with the lock-on button), the rest by seat. A-2 and the driver's ПВ reach the left set (SAM3D's choice).

powered.description: powered on the march: turbine running, equipment and stabilisation warm, search possible on the move
powered.source: wrk (search possible on the move); mon_2112_80 p11-12 (readiness within 4 min); video_osa (a powered battery deploys in 35-50 s, unverified)
powered.notes: What a battery on the march with the equipment already running looks like. The function check is not counted as done.

deployed.description: deployed at a halt: on the take-off generator, launcher unlocked, drives on, vehicle oriented
deployed.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p246-247 (readiness drill: power, deploy, orientation); flak11
deployed.notes: A vehicle in a firing position, waiting for targets with the radars silent.

sensors.notes: Maps the SOC, SSC and TOV onto this console for the gameplay engagement model (simcore/engagement.hpp). Gameplay thresholds live in data/gameplay/osa_ak.json.

receiver.notes: voenizdat_osa_1991 p27, p36-37, p49 (coherence and the wind compensation), p33-36 (РПЧМ — АПЧМ), p30, p36, p266 (СА). The knobs' spans are SAM3D's estimates: ГРУБО ±30 m/s and ТОЧНО ±5 m/s at their ends (enough for wind-blown chaff), РЕГ. РПЧМ ±5 MHz (docs/research/OSA_CHECKS_RECEIVERS_DRIVES_2026-11.md).

beams.source: flak11 and korovin_tiv_2010 (33 rpm; the beam is switched to one of three positions each turn); samsim_osa p15 (selector: ЛУЧ I, II, III, АВТ. I-III, АВТ. I-II); mon_2112_80 p15, p21
beams.notes: Positions of soc.beam: I, II, III hold one beam; АВТ. I-III steps through all three, one per turn, and АВТ. I-II through the lower two. The rings are the ePap rings (samsim_thread): the 0-15 km scale has them at 2, 7 and 12 km, the others every 5 km from the origin (SAM3D reads that as multiples of 5 km inside the window).

iff.source: mon_2112_80 p21 (general interrogation ЗАПРОС and ЗАПРОС К: the reply is a 20° arc on the PPI; or the gated mode, where the search echo gates the reply and the mark is much narrower), p14 (the interrogator NRZ's antenna is built into the search antenna); voenizdat_osa_1991 p17 (a reply puts a «свой» mark beside the echo), p55 (ЗАПРОС К is a control interrogation confirming a friend), p66 (КОНТР. ИНД. puts the check marks on the PPI), p53 (identification range at least 30 km, 1L24-2), p56 (1 s per press)
iff.notes: The interrogator works with the search radar radiating (SAM3D). Range and query time are the 1991 textbook's for the AKM's 1L24-2; the Osa-AK's interrogator may differ. Gated mode: КЛАПАН. КОНТР. ИНД.: one general check mark at 10 km on every sweep, a ring round the PPI while held: the range is SAM3D's; the AKM's set shows eight more in VII–II (p66), not drawn.

search.notes: Scales p15 item 5; СДЦ works to 35 km, p15 item 12.

receiver.notes: The tracking radar has internal coherence only (voenizdat_osa_1991 p72, p80) and no СА. Spans as the search radar's (SAM3D's estimates).

elevation_search.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p95 (in ЦУ the SSC antenna searches in elevation within the search beam the target was detected in; the OS81-10M auto-capture circuit, armed by ЦУ and АЗ, fires when the target is in the antenna's beam and the range gate is on it), p86 (the scan comes from self-oscillation of the elevation drive; beam commands I, II, III from the search radar), Fig. 2.37 p97 (beam I −1° to 5°, II 3° to 9°, III 6° to 30°); korovin_tiv_2010 (tracking beam 1°)
elevation_search.notes: Scan period: SAM3D estimate. In the automatic beam programmes (АВТ. I–III, I–II) SAM3D searches the beam the search radar sees the target in nearest the azimuth line (the real scan follows the search radar's beam commands). mon_2112_80 p21 gives I–II as 0–8° and I–III as 0–28°: the textbook's figure is used.

track.notes: SSC displayed range 28 km (p16); ±330° azimuth (p14, p16; voenizdat_osa_1991 p66; mon_2112_80 p25 gives ±342° for the turret). TV fields 00-60 x 00-80 (3.6 x 4.8°) wide and 00-18 x 00-24 (1.08 x 1.44°) narrow (voenizdat_osa_1991 p101; an operator on samsim_thread gives the same); the larger figure is used. SAM Simulator's manual gives 5° / 1.5°. fov_height_ratio 0.75 is the height over the width of those fields (00-60 over 00-80), used for the lens field in manual TV tracking. The fast slew lever ВЛЕВО — ВПРАВО (ssc.slew, voenizdat_osa_1991 p99: the АПУ's fast slew) turns the antenna at 30°/s, SAM Simulator's (5-00 a second while held: docs/research/OSA_CONSOLE_MAP_2026-10.md). ПА is aided tracking (voenizdat_osa_1991 p87-88, p73): the wheels' turns feed an integrator that turns the antenna on at its rate, up to 30°/s in azimuth and 15°/s in elevation (p85); its gain, 0.5 per second (a degree turned adds half a degree a second), is SAM3D's estimate. The range automaton's balance holds the gate off the echo by up to 60 m at the knob's ends: SAM3D's estimate, under the gate's half-width. The light filter's factors on the visibility are haze's extinction at the filter's colour against the clear band's (Ångström exponent 1.3: blue 450 nm, clear 550 nm, orange 600 nm), SAM3D's reading (docs/research/OSA_CHECKS_RECEIVERS_DRIVES_2026-11.md).

orientation.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p48 (gyro half-compass GA-3 measures the vehicle's heading Qc once oriented; the Qc found with an artillery compass and the TV sight by mutual sighting is set on the setter ЗК-4; with АК — ЗК at ЗК and РЕЛЕ — Qc at Qc the setter is connected and the correction motor turns the GA-3; СОГЛАСОВАНИЕ speeds it up; agreement is checked on the Qc scale of OR-31M, which stops), p50–52 (block 0005-8M; ПОТРЕБИТЕЛИ ОСН. — КОНТР. connects ЗК-4 to the ГА-3 at ОСН., p51), p246 (the deputy crew chief orients the vehicle at a halt), p249 (Qc: clockwise from north to the vehicle's axis); mon_2112_80 pp. 63–68 (orientation is lost when the equipment is switched off)
orientation.notes: Rates are SAM3D estimates. The GA-3 runs on vehicle power (SAM3D); without it, the frame starts again taking the hull to face north. Holding СОГЛАСОВАНИЕ is one press in SAM3D: the fast turn continues until the scales agree. Drift (simcore/orientation.hpp): the Earth's rate 15.041 deg/h times sin(latitude) is textbook physics of the directional gyro; the latitude correction (p51: ШИРОТА potentiometer, used with РЕЛЕ — Qc at РЕЛЕ once oriented, p48) cancels the part set on its scale. own_drift_deg_h 0.5 is a SAM3D estimate: no source gives the GA-3's own drift, and this is of the order of a directional gyro of the period, so an hour or two shows it (its sign is drawn per run). The crew chief's compass work (p249-250: the ПАБ 20-50 m ahead, the launcher laid on it with the TV sight, mutual sighting, the compass correction, Qc = α − qв) is his drill measure_qc, out at the aiming circle and back (data/vehicles/osa_ak.json): the survey runs from setting it up to the reading (the subsystem qc_measured), and he tells the deputy the Qc once back in earshot; broken off for a target, he stows it (break_off_qc). survey_sigma_deg 0.2 (about 0-03) is a SAM3D estimate.

A fault the scenario or the instructor sets (set_input); it also comes about by itself, by its circuit's hours (data/gameplay/osa_ak_faults.json, docs/FAULTS.md).
inputs.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p50 (0096-9M1: the lamp ОБРЫВ ФАЗЫ ψ, γ, lit on faults in the three-phase supply of the drives' hydraulic pumps), p53

inputs.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p166 (indicator lamps in 0096-9M1 and 0096-10M show a blown fuse in each system's supply), p101 (the fuse lamps of the ССЦ's supply blocks dark in the function check)

controls.label: АВАР. ОТКЛ. СЭП
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p163 (the button АВАР. ОТКЛ. СЭП on the ПАНЕЛЬ ИНДИКАЦИИ is part of the power system; p164: the power system is controlled from the driver's instrument panel, PU-303 and the ПАНЕЛЬ ИНДИКАЦИИ); wwp_gecko g095-b: a dark red lens in a red ring at the plate's left, СЭП over it and АВАР. ОТКЛ. under it
controls.notes: On the vehicle it looks like a lamp: SAM3D draws it as a lit push-button, the manual's button with its lamp (the lamp sep_avar_otkl), lit while the cut holds. Pressed, it cuts the equipment's power whatever source runs (the subsystem sep_cut). It holds until the ГТА and АППАРАТУРА ВКЛ. are both off: how the loads are put back on the real vehicle (PU-303's load buttons) is not modelled, so SAM3D's restart.

controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p163 (the frequency monitor УКЧ in OS52-16M cuts the load when the supply's frequency falls to 360 Hz); wwp_gecko g095-b: a toggle lever in a red ring at the plate's right, УКЧ over it, ВКЛ. above and ОТКЛ. below at its right
controls.notes: The frequency monitor УКЧ (in ОС52-16М): in, it sheds the load when the supply falls to 360 Hz (voenizdat_osa_1991 p163; data/vehicles/osa_ak_systems.json, simcore/vehicle_systems.hpp). Starts at ВКЛ.: SAM3D's choice.

controls.label: ПЕРЕКЛЮЧАТЕЛЬ ПАНЕЛИ ИНДИКАЦИИ
controls.source: wwp_gecko g095-b (a pointer knob on a black plate, seven positions 30 degrees apart: ОТКЛ. at the top, 1— and 2— legible on each side, a 3 at each end); voenizdat_osa_1991 p247 (the launch табло are named by missile and channel, 1—II, 2—II, 3—II, 3—I, 2—I, 1—I: in «К бою» the deputy checks none flashes)
controls.notes: A rotary selector: with ОТКАЗ it gives the forced refusal of the missile standing on preparation in the container it names (voenizdat_osa_1991 p151, p156; the launcher's refuse block). The legends' numbers are the photo's; that the second figure is the channel (II on the left, as КАНАЛ II stands on the left of the launch console) is SAM3D's reading. Starts at ОТКЛ.

controls.label: ШКАЛА КУРСОВОГО ПАРАМЕТРА
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p41-42 (the PPI's frame carries a turning scale with seven lines, 2 km of range apart, to measure the target's course parameter), p256 (the parametric ruler is set parallel to the target's course); wwp_gecko g095-a (the seven lines on the disc, the orange knurled knobs on the bezel)

controls.label: φ АВТ. — РУЧН.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p50-51 (block 0005-8M, the gyros' switch-on panel) (connects the latitude correction of panel ПУ-11 to the GA-3; start position РУЧН.), p48
controls.notes: At РУЧН. the latitude set on ШИРОТА (orient.latitude) corrects the gyro's drift; at АВТ. the correction would come from ПУ-11, which SAM3D does not model, so the gyro drifts at the Earth's full rate for the site (the orientation's latitude_switch). Which of the black panel's four toggles it is: SAM3D's choice (the one beside the ШИРОТА knob).

controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p50-51 (block 0005-8M, the gyros' switch-on panel) (changes the gyros' power source; start position СЕТЬ); wwp_gecko g086-a, g091-a (the toggle at the right end of 0005-8M's middle row, its legend legible)
controls.notes: Placed in the cabin, nothing reads it: the gyros' supply is not modelled.

controls.label: РЕЛЕ — Ψ, Θ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p50-51 (block 0005-8M, the gyros' switch-on panel) (switches off the GA-3's horizontal correction; start position Ψ, Θ)
controls.notes: Placed in the cabin, nothing reads it: the gyros' correction is not modelled. Which toggle it is: SAM3D's choice.

controls.label: ОБОГРЕВ — ВКЛ.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p50-51 (block 0005-8M, the gyros' switch-on panel) (heats the GA-3 below +5 °C in the operators' compartment)
controls.notes: ОБОГРЕВ: the gyro's heating, wanted when the operators' compartment is below +5 C (voenizdat_osa_1991 p51): then the gyro erects only with it on (subsystem gyro_warm; the cabin's temperature in data/vehicles/osa_ak_systems.json, simcore/vehicle_systems.hpp). Which toggle it is: SAM3D's choice.

controls.label: ПОТРЕБИТЕЛИ ОСН. — КОНТР.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p51 (block 0005-8M: ПОТРЕБИТЕЛИ ОСН. — КОНТР. connects ЗК-4 to the ГА-3 at ОСН.)
controls.notes: Placed in the cabin at 0005-8M's free toggle (the second row's left, wwp_gecko g091-a; which toggle it is: SAM3D's choice); at КОНТР. the course setter is off the gyro and cannot slave it (the orientation's consumers_control). КОРРЕКЦИЯ ОСН. — КОНТР. (the latitude correction to the ГА-3, p51) is not found on the photo: PLANNED p:gyro_sw.

controls.label: ПРИВОД γ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p51 (block 0009-5M, the drives' amplifiers) (switches the drive off for maintenance); wwp_gecko g091-a (its legend legible on the photo)
controls.notes: At ОТКЛ. the stabilisation stops (stabilisation), as ПРИВОД Ψ. The guarded toggle on the right under its legend.

controls.notes: At ОТКЛ. the stabilisation's control circuit has no supply and the stabilisation stops (stabilisation). That it is the third guarded toggle, low on the block, is SAM3D's reading.

controls.label: КОНТРОЛЬ РАБОТЫ (ОС51-8М)
controls.source: wwp_gecko g091-a (the selector under КОНТРОЛЬ РАБОТЫ beside the meter of block OS51-8M); voenizdat_osa_1991 p72 (OS51-8M is the MTI block, БСО СДЦ, of the receiving system)
controls.notes: Placed in the cabin, nothing reads it: the block's self-check is not modelled. Its positions' legends are too small to transcribe: numbered.

controls.label: СС — ОТКЛ.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p51 (block OR-31M: switches off the follow-up systems Ψ, Θ, Qc for maintenance), p41 (OR-31M's resolvers turn the scope's sweep by Qc)
controls.notes: At ОТКЛ. the Qc follow-up stops (the orientation's follow_up_control): the scales hold and the crew's frame keeps the Qc it had, so the scope and the wheels' azimuths turn with the hull until СС is put back. The only toggle on block OR-31M in sp2m_trace (M0).

controls.label: ТОК, МОЩНОСТЬ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49 (on 0062-6M1 the switch ТОК, МОЩНОСТЬ and the meters МОЩНОСТЬ ГЕНЕРАТОРА, ТОК ГЕНЕРАТОРА, for the magnetrons' mean current and power), p50 (it switches between the transmitters of the СОЦ, ССЦ, СНК and СПК), p52, p100, p120 (its positions СОЦ, ССЦ, СПК-I, СПК-II)
controls.notes: Chooses the transmitter the two meters read (the displays tx_current and tx_power). The order of its positions is SAM3D's choice; the knob is the upper of the two stacked right of the МОЩНОСТЬ meter, ТОК, МОЩНОСТЬ over it (wwp_gecko g094-b).

controls.label: РЕЖИМЫ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (switch РЕЖИМЫ on block 0062-6M1, with КАНАЛЫ and the meter КОНТРОЛЬ, for checks); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-b (the lower of the two stacked knobs; SAM Simulator's AK photo has РЕЖИМЫ under it)
controls.notes: Picks the receiver's channel the noise check reads on КОНТРОЛЬ: 1 the search radar (ГШ-2), 2 the tracking radar's first channel (ГШ-5), 3 its second; 4 and 5 not modelled. Positions numbered: their legends are not in the sources, what each is SAM3D's reading of p161 (simcore/checks.hpp, the console's "checks"; the readings SAM3D's).

controls.label: ПОДЖИГ ГШ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (on 0062-6M1: the button ПОДЖИГ ГШ, with the switches КАНАЛЫ, РЕЖИМЫ and the meter КОНТРОЛЬ), p161 (pressed, it fires the noise generators ГШ-2 and ГШ-5 in the search and tracking radars' feeders; the meter shows the channels' sensitivity); wwp_gecko g094-b (a red-capped button under its legend)
controls.notes: Held, the noise generator of the channel РЕЖИМЫ picks feeds its receiver: КОНТРОЛЬ rises by a sound receiver's noise figure, less by a degraded one's (simcore/checks.hpp).

controls.label: РРУ КШ ОСН.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (on 0062-6M1 the knobs РРУ КШ ОСН. and РРУ КШ ДОП., used in checking the noise figure, and the switch АРУ — РРУ, which switches off the ССЦ's automatic gain control for maintenance); wwp_gecko g094-b (the upper of the two knobs right of the meter КОНТРОЛЬ)
controls.notes: The SSC receiver's gain by hand while АРУ — РРУ is at РРУ: the grass and the echoes on the range indicator (ssc_range's picture). In the noise check, the level on КОНТРОЛЬ of the search radar's channel and the tracking radar's first, set before ПОДЖИГ ГШ (simcore/checks.hpp, the console's "checks"; the readings SAM3D's).

controls.label: АРУ — РРУ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (on 0062-6M1 the knobs РРУ КШ ОСН. and РРУ КШ ДОП., used in checking the noise figure, and the switch АРУ — РРУ, which switches off the ССЦ's automatic gain control for maintenance); wwp_gecko g094-b (which toggle: SAM3D's choice)
controls.notes: АРУ in combat work. At РРУ the range indicator's gain is set by hand on РРУ КШ ОСН. (ssc_range's picture: gain_when).

controls.label: РРУ КШ ДОП.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (on 0062-6M1 the knobs РРУ КШ ОСН. and РРУ КШ ДОП., used in checking the noise figure, and the switch АРУ — РРУ, which switches off the ССЦ's automatic gain control for maintenance); wwp_gecko g094-b (the lower of the two knobs right of the meter КОНТРОЛЬ, the legend РРУ КШ ДОП. under them)
controls.notes: РРУ КШ ДОП.: in the noise check, the level of the tracking radar's second channel on КОНТРОЛЬ, set before ПОДЖИГ ГШ (simcore/checks.hpp, the console's "checks"; the readings SAM3D's). Read as a КОНТРОЛЬ knob until 12 Nov 2026 (КОНТРОЛЬ is the meter); its id is kept.

controls.label: РПЧМ — АПЧМ (ССЦ)
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (block OS81-9M: manual or automatic control of the magnetron's frequency), p33-36 (АПЧМ's ±0.5 MHz); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: At АПЧМ the magnetron is held on tune (±0.5 MHz, voenizdat_osa_1991 p33-36); at РПЧМ it sits where РЕГ. РПЧМ puts it, on tune at the middle. Off tune every echo weakens (3 dB at the passband's edge) and past ±0.5 MHz the MTI stops cancelling, gone at ±1 MHz (SAM3D's reading, the receiver block's afc_control).

controls.label: ССЦ РПЧМ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (the slotted potentiometer ССЦ РПЧМ on OS81-9M); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: At РПЧМ the magnetron's tune: ±5 MHz at its ends, on tune at the middle (SAM3D's estimate of the span); at АПЧМ it does nothing.

controls.label: ЯРКОСТЬ СТРОБА Р
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98, p119 (block OS81-9M: the brightness of the missile gate on the coarse range sweep); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: A potentiometer, turned without stops between its ends; it sets the SVR gate's mark on the coarse sweep (ScopePictureOf, data/cabins/osa_ak.json "picture").

controls.source: samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)

controls.label: АСТИГМАТ. II
controls.source: samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)

controls.label: ВЕРТ. СМЕЩ. II
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p99; samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)

controls.label: ГОРИЗ. СМЕЩ. II
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p99; samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: Moves the second trace across the screen (ssc_range's picture).

controls.label: ЯРКОСТЬ II
controls.source: samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)

controls.label: КОМПЕНСАЦИЯ ВЕТРА ГРУБО
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (block OS61-5M1: the knobs ГРУБО, ТОЧНО compensate the clutter's Doppler); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: With КОМПЕНС. ВЕТРА on, the offset's coarse part: ±30 m/s at its ends, none at the middle (SAM3D's estimate of the span; the knob is the textbook's, p36-37).

controls.label: КОМПЕНСАЦИЯ ВЕТРА ТОЧНО
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98; samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: With КОМПЕНС. ВЕТРА on, the offset's fine part: ±5 m/s at its ends (SAM3D's estimate).

controls.label: КОМПЕНС. ВЕТРА — ОТКЛ. (ССЦ)
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (block OS61-5M1: the wind compensation in СДЦ); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: In СДЦ with internal coherence the canceller's notch moves to the offset the ГРУБО and ТОЧНО knobs set (the receiver block's wind_comp_control): what drifts at that radial speed (wind-blown chaff) cancels, and the ground clutter, at none, stops cancelling once the offset is past the notch. Set by hand until the clutter cancels on the range indicator (voenizdat_osa_1991 p36-37, p49, p98, p266).

controls.label: ДОП. УСИЛ. — ОТКЛ.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (block OS61-5M1: more gain in the range channel); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: Raises the range channel's gain by half (SAM3D's figure): more grass on the range indicator (ssc_range's picture: gain_boost).

controls.label: АВТОМАТ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (block OS81-18M: the button АВТОМАТ and its lamp put the range finder on automatic tracking); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: Puts the range on the radar, as ПОЛУАВТОМАТ does (range_semi_auto): the two modes are not told apart.

controls.label: РУЧНОЕ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p98 (block OS81-18M: the button РУЧНОЕ puts the range finder on manual, by the hand wheel); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: Ends АВТОМАТ or ПОЛУАВТОМАТ (range_semi_auto): the range is the hand wheel's again while the angles come from the TV.

controls.label: СКОРОСТЬ П А
controls.source: samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: Placed in the cabin, nothing reads it. The semi-automatic range tracking's rate (SAM Simulator's label).

controls.label: БАЛАНС АВТОМАТА
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p119 (the potentiometer БАЛАНС on block OK81-4M balances the range finder's discriminators); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat op_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: Off its middle the range gate sits off the echo in АВТОМАТ and ПОЛУАВТОМАТ, by up to 60 m at its ends (sensors.track range_balance_control): the range read is that much out. SAM3D's reading by analogy with OK81-4M's БАЛАНС (p119); the textbook does not describe OS81-18M's.

controls.label: ОСВЕЩ. ШКАЛЫ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (the PPI's knob ОСВЕЩЕНИЕ ШКАЛЫ lights the azimuth scale); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: A potentiometer, turned without stops between its ends; it sets the azimuth scale's lighting (ScopePictureOf, data/cabins/osa_ak.json "picture").

controls.label: КОНТР. ИНД.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p66 (КОНТР. ИНД. puts the IFF's check marks on the PPI; the AKM's 1Л24-2); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: Held with the interrogator ready, it puts the check signal's mark on the PPI at 10 km on every sweep (sensors.search.iff check_control), a ring as the antenna turns (voenizdat_osa_1991 p66). The mark's range is SAM3D's.

controls.label: ЯРКОСТЬ МЕТОК
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (PPI knob); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: A potentiometer, turned without stops between its ends; it sets the search scope's range marks (ScopePictureOf, data/cabins/osa_ak.json "picture").

controls.label: ФОКУС
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (PPI knob); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: A potentiometer, turned without stops between its ends; it sets the search scope's focus: sharp at its middle (ScopePictureOf, data/cabins/osa_ak.json "picture").

controls.label: КОНТРАСТНОСТЬ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (PPI knob); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: A potentiometer, turned without stops between its ends; it sets the echoes against the noise on the search scope (ScopePictureOf, data/cabins/osa_ak.json "picture").

controls.label: РПЧМ — АПЧМ (СОЦ)
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (OP81-16M2: РПЧМ — АПЧМ, РЕГ. РПЧМ), p33-36 (АПЧМ's ±0.5 MHz); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: At АПЧМ the magnetron is held on tune (±0.5 MHz, voenizdat_osa_1991 p33-36); at РПЧМ it sits where РЕГ. РПЧМ puts it, on tune at the middle. Off tune every echo weakens (3 dB at the passband's edge) and past ±0.5 MHz the MTI stops cancelling, gone at ±1 MHz (SAM3D's reading, the receiver block's afc_control).

controls.label: РЕГ. РПЧМ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50; samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: At РПЧМ the magnetron's tune: ±5 MHz at its ends, on tune at the middle (SAM3D's estimate of the span); at АПЧМ it does nothing.

controls.label: ЯРКОСТЬ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (PPI knob); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: A potentiometer, turned without stops between its ends; it sets the search scope's sweep, noise and echoes: dark below a fifth of its turn (ScopePictureOf, data/cabins/osa_ak.json "picture"). Starts turned down: the senior operator brings it up once the sweep shows, a minute after the equipment is switched on (voenizdat_osa_1991 p52; data/crew/osa_ak_crew.json "settings").

controls.label: ЯРКОСТЬ ВИЗИРА
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (PPI knob); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: A potentiometer, turned without stops between its ends; it sets the SSC cursor on the search scope (ScopePictureOf, data/cabins/osa_ak.json "picture").

controls.label: РРУ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (OP63-6M3: РРУ, the receiver's manual gain, full for combat); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: A potentiometer, turned without stops between its ends; it sets the search scope's noise and echoes and the width of a noise jammer's sector; the radar's detection is not changed by it (ScopePictureOf, data/cabins/osa_ak.json "picture"). Starts full: in combat the gain stands full, turned clockwise to the stop (voenizdat_osa_1991 p52).

controls.label: КОМПЕНС. ВЕТРА — ОТКЛ. (СОЦ)
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (OP63-6M3), p36-37 (the wind compensation); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: In СДЦ with internal coherence the canceller's notch moves to the offset the ГРУБО and ТОЧНО knobs set (the receiver block's wind_comp_control): what drifts at that radial speed (wind-blown chaff) cancels, and the ground clutter, at none, stops cancelling once the offset is past the notch. Set by hand until the clutter cancels on the PPI (voenizdat_osa_1991 p36-37, p49, p98, p266).

controls.label: КОМПЕНСАЦИЯ ВЕТРА ГРУБО (СОЦ)
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (OP63-6M3: wind compensation ГРУБО / ТОЧНО); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: With КОМПЕНС. ВЕТРА on, the offset's coarse part: ±30 m/s at its ends, none at the middle (SAM3D's estimate of the span; the knob is the textbook's, p36-37).

controls.label: КОМПЕНСАЦИЯ ВЕТРА ТОЧНО (СОЦ)
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50; samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: With КОМПЕНС. ВЕТРА on, the offset's fine part: ±5 m/s at its ends (SAM3D's estimate).

controls.label: СА — ОТКЛ.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (OP63-6M3: protection against strong pulse jamming), p30, p36, p266 (anti-asynchronous: against non-synchronous pulse jamming); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: СА blanks pulses out of step with the radar's own repetition (neighbouring radars, an asynchronous repeater's false targets: voenizdat_osa_1991 p30, p36, p266) at a small cost to the echo (1 dB, SAM3D's estimate). A synchronous repeater passes it.

controls.label: СДЦ ВНЕШН. — ВНУТР.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p49-50 (OP63-6M3), p27, p265-266 (external coherence); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: ВНЕШН. takes the canceller's phase from the clutter itself: ground clutter and wind-blown chaff cancel together without the wind compensation (voenizdat_osa_1991 p27, p265-266; MtiMode::External). ВНУТР. phases it from the transmitter's pulse, the wind compensation moving its notch.

controls.label: БАЛАНС ПА (АЗИМУТ)
controls.source: samsim_osa (the console's labels); voenizdat_osa_1991 p87-88 (ПА's rate integrator, which SAM3D takes it to balance); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: In ПА it clears the azimuth integrator's rate (sensors.track pa_balance_az): the antenna stops carrying on. What the button does is SAM3D's reading (low): the sources name it only on the console; the integrator is the textbook's (voenizdat_osa_1991 p87-88). On the azimuth hand wheel's block OS52-12M1.

controls.label: ВЛЕВО — ВПРАВО
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p99 (block OS52-12M1: the switch turns on the АПУ's slew in azimuth), p87-88 (the slew in РУ or ЦУ, at the АПУ's highest allowed speed); samsim_osa (the console's labels; the lever held on a mouse button); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: A spring lever, held off its middle (springs_back: SAM Simulator's, held on a mouse button; the textbook, p87-88 and p99, says only that setting it switches the slew on). Held, the drive turns the antenna post, the azimuth wheel's reading, left (anticlockwise) or right at 30°/s, in РУ or ЦУ only (p87-88: not in ПА, and no target held), with the antenna free to turn and the wheel unlocked (sensors.track slew_control; EngagementModel::Slew). In the cabin the left mouse button holds it at ВЛЕВО, the right at ВПРАВО, as in SAM Simulator.

controls.label: ЭМУ ОТКЛ. — ВКЛ.
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p99 (block OS52-12M1: cuts the ЭМУ's control winding to hold the launcher still with the azimuth drive on); samsim_osa (the console's labels); wwp_gecko g094-a (its place, the view flat so_panel_g094a)
controls.notes: Off, the azimuth drive stops (subsystem azimuth_drive): the turret does not turn in any mode, so nothing is aimed, tracked or slewed in azimuth. The wheel and the scope's marker follow the hand all the same (p86).

controls.label: ЧАСТОТА
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p162 (on 0004-14M: the knob ЧАСТОТА retunes the target channel's quartz oscillator); wwp_gecko g095-b, g094-a (the round knob under РЕЖИМЫ, its legend legible)
controls.notes: Tunes the target channel's quartz oscillator in the check: the КАНАЛ Ц meters read their full value with the knob on tune (mid-scale), falling to nothing 0.2 of its turn either side. Was tov.freq, on the TV's block after samsim_osa, until 12 Nov 2026: the manual names one ЧАСТОТА on this column, 0004-14M's, and the photos show it there (simcore/checks.hpp, the console's "checks"; the readings SAM3D's).

controls.label: РЕЖИМЫ
controls.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p162 (on 0004-14M: РЕЖИМЫ checks the target's and missile's error signals, СОЦ, Р; СМЕНА ЗНАКА СОЦ, Р; КОМПЕНСАЦИЯ Ц, Р, and ССЦ and СОЦ with MTI, ПП ССЦ and ПП СОЦ); wwp_gecko g095-b (the bat knob right of the lever, its arc's legends legible in part)
controls.notes: In ФК the four meters show the check of the position chosen (the cabin's levels): SAM3D's readings, the sources giving none (half-scale for СО Ц, Р, the other way with СМЕНА ЗНАКА, zero compensated, a smaller deflection for the moving-target checks); dead on the target channel with the fault error_channel_fault. A function-check switch: nothing reads it (the four meters rest at zero, as ТСЦ leaves them). The order of the positions: SAM3D's from the text.

controls.label: ВЫВОД — НАВЕДЕНИЕ

procedures.name: Firing at a jamming target (ПОМЕХА, method Н)
procedures.source: samsim_osa p34 and samsim_thread (ПОМЕХА: method Н against a jammer, the fuse armed with the medium beam because there is no range); korovin_tiv_2010 PDF p24 (in heavy jamming the range is taken from the search radar); seat: flak11 (9A33-3)
procedures.notes: Deputy commander, when the tracking radar's echo is lost in the jamming and it follows the jammer in angle. The operator keeps the range wheel on the target's blip on the search scope, or on the range the battery commander gave; ЦЕЛЬ В ЗОНЕ then lights from that range. Without any range the NPC waits: firing blind is the commander's decision. The order of the steps is SAM3D's, after emcon_tv_engagement.

procedures.name: Counter a range-gate pull-off (УВ. ПОМЕХА, СДЦ)
procedures.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p80-81 (the trailing-edge circuit against a pull-off that walks out; СДЦ's staggered periods against one that walks in), p259 (only when automatic tracking is impossible), p266 (firing at a pull-off in the УВОДЯЩАЯ ПОМЕХА mode)
procedures.notes: Operator, when he sees the target's mark split from the jamming pulse on the range indicator (range_pulled) and the commander orders it. After a pull-off has taken the gate away the lock is usually lost when the repeater falls silent; with the protection on the next capture holds. Both switches in one drill: he can't tell at once which way the pulse walks.

procedures.name: Orient the vehicle (gyro half-compass to the crew chief's Qc)
procedures.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p246 (drill: the deputy crew chief sets АК — ЗК to ЗК, the commanded Qc on ЗК-4, РЕЛЕ — Qc to Qc, holds СОГЛАСОВАНИЕ until the Qc scale on OR-31M stops, then АК and РЕЛЕ), p48, p249 (the crew chief finds Qc with an artillery compass)
procedures.notes: Deputy commander, at a halt, once the gyros are up (the driver's АРРЕТИР.) and the crew chief has commanded Qc from his compass work (qc_known). The Qc goes on the setter after ЗК (an NPC deputy sets it there, and the latitude; the player hears it and sees it in the log). Orientation is lost when the equipment is switched off; left alone the gyro drifts, so a long session needs orienting again.
